cues: e-governance is government using ICT to serve citizens, businesses and its own offices.
Four types: government to citizen, like the Nagarik App; government to business, like online VAT filing; government to government, like a shared national ID database; and government to employee.
It brings transparency and fewer queues, but faces the digital divide and cyber security risks.
